title: Deny Without Disabling: Authorization-Paired Evaluation and Control for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.00371v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems derive their capabilities from sharing evidence, delegating tasks, and combining information across agents. The same process creates a safety problem: contributions that are admissible in isolation can jointly enable a prohibited use. Blocking every sensitive action avoids disclosure but defeats the purpose of collaboration. We introduce authorization-paired evaluation, which makes blocking prohibited uses and completing required authorized uses a joint success criterion, and FlowReview, a framework connecting object resolution, permission ranking, and deterministic enforcement. In controlled composition experiments, reviewing combined artifacts reduces the denied-commit rate from 86.0% to zero with no loss of authorized supply. Our findings show that preserving information and lineage alone does not ensure correct permission attribution. Object identity and permission must remain connected to execution through comp

translated_title: 拒绝而不禁用：面向多智能体系统的授权配对评估与控制
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统的能力来源于跨智能体共享证据、委托任务和组合信息。同样的过程也带来了安全隐患：单独看可被接受的贡献，组合起来却可能促成被禁止的用途。若阻止所有敏感操作，虽然可以避免泄露，却违背了协作的初衷。我们提出了授权配对评估，将“阻止被禁止的用途”与“完成所需的授权用途”作为联合成功标准，并提出了FlowReview框架，将对象解析、权限排序与确定性执行相连接。在受控组合实验中，对组合产物进行审查可将拒绝提交率从86.0%降至零，且不损失任何授权供应。我们的研究结果表明，仅保留信息和来源谱系并不足以确保正确的权限归属，对象身份与权限必须通过执行过程中的组合保持连接……
tldr: 该论文提出“授权配对评估”方法和FlowReview框架，通过将阻止违禁用途与完成授权用途设定为联合成功标准，并对多智能体系统中的组合产物进行对象解析、权限排序和确定性执行审查，使拒绝提交率从86.0%降至零，同时不损失授权协作能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces authorization-paired evaluation and the FlowReview framework, which jointly treat blocking prohibited uses and completing authorized uses as a single success criterion, reducing the denied-commit rate in multi-agent composition experiments from 86.0% to zero without any loss of authorized supply.
